steps.subject: sky
steps.action: small circle of white brown and yellow in the sky
steps.load: small mix of white brown and yellow

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: ring of brown and blue around the circle
steps.load: brown with a little blue added
steps.motion: make another circle around it and work around

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: work blue from the black area up to the circle

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: dark brown and blue in the very back

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: small sun in the center
steps.load: white on the one inch brush

steps.subject: sun/glow
steps.action: knife takes off excess and blends the sun

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: storm clouds in brown and blue with a touch of crimson
steps.load: more brown than blue with a tiny crimson
steps.motion: push into the canvas and bend the knife
steps.rule: blue is much stronger so use more brown

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: pull the storm paint with a clean dry brush

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: cloud ground into the canvas
steps.load: brown and blue on the knife

steps.subject: other: rain
steps.action: far rain in the distance

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the excess paint with the large brush
steps.motion: blend lightly to pick up excess
steps.rule: picking up excess keeps it from smearing

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: sprinkle titanium white highlights on the clouds

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: lift excess white off with the knife
steps.rule: excess paint would smear, so wipe the knife between strokes

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the clouds very gently with a large brush
steps.rule: keeps the darkness for a mean-looking storm

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: small clouds floating in front
steps.motion: let them fall in and blend gently

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: push clouds further back and add a cloud
steps.load: a little prussian blue on the brush
steps.rule: pushing clouds back creates a lot of distance

steps.subject: water line
steps.action: start the water with the knife and thin white
steps.load: very little white on the knife
steps.motion: lay a little paint on, start center and work outward
steps.rule: where black and white meet gives the water line

steps.subject: water
steps.action: blend the water across with a clean dry large brush

steps.subject: reflection
steps.action: yellow reflections under the water
steps.load: very small amount of yellow with white
steps.rule: blue underneath turns the yellow greenish when blended

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: little waves with a fan brush
steps.load: tiny bit of magic white on the fan brush
steps.motion: let waves fall out of the brush
steps.rule: magic white thins the paint so it spreads

steps.subject: land
steps.action: dark coastline hill in crimson and brown
steps.where: back here, running down into the water

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: splash white up on the coastline
steps.rule: shows water hitting and splashing up the edges

steps.subject: land
steps.action: big cliff coming down to the water
steps.motion: brush strokes in the direction of the land

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: splash white up into the rocks
steps.motion: water slides up against the rocks

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: silhouettes of little trees in the back

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: liner trunks with a little oil
steps.where: way back here, here and there

steps.subject: far trees
steps.action: very light ochre highlights on the trees
steps.motion: very light highlights here and there
steps.rule: just enough to break it up so it reads as trees

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: big splashing wave with white
steps.load: more white on the fan brush

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: curl and pull the big wave with white
steps.motion: draw a little curl then pull over

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: yellow glow through the wave turning green
steps.load: yellow on top then a little white
steps.motion: tap yellow on top and let it turn green
steps.where: inside the wave where light shows through
steps.rule: yellow over blue turns green so the light glows through

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: darken right behind the wave with straight blue
steps.load: straight blue on another fan brush

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: big stone out in the water

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: umber highlight on the stone
steps.motion: lay a highlight on the stone
steps.rule: the stone is dark so the highlight stays dull

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: water splashing up over the stone
steps.motion: let water run down following the wave
steps.where: on the stone and the wave

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: another small stone with umber highlight
steps.motion: lay a little highlight on top

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: splash running up the stone
steps.motion: make water run up the stone

steps.subject: rock
steps.action: stone marks with burnt umber from the knife
steps.load: a touch of burnt umber on the knife
steps.rule: pushing hard mushes the paint into the canvas

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: quick foam splash up the rocks
steps.rule: a fast motion makes the foam happen better

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: thin white dribble over the rocks
steps.motion: barely touch and let it dribble

steps.subject: ocean/wave
steps.action: soften the bright area with the large brush

steps.subject: other: signature
steps.action: sign the painting in red
steps.load: red thinned with a little oil
